title: SynAct: Synergistic Active Feedback Learning for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.12651v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents executing multi-step workflows fail in two fundamentally different ways: recoverable slips, which further attempts can repair, and knowledge gaps, which retrying cannot resolve. Expert feedback can address the latter, but expert attention is scarce. The key challenge is therefore not whether to ask for feedback, but where feedback can change the outcome. Existing approaches either avoid expert feedback, allowing agents to reinforce their own errors, or allocate feedback at the task level without identifying consequential decisions. We present SynAct, an active learning framework that treats expert attention as the binding constraint and allocates feedback at the level of individual decisions. translated_title: SynAct：面向大语言模型智能体的协同主动反馈学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.12651v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：执行多步骤工作流的大语言模型（LLM）智能体以两种根本不同的方式失败：可恢复的失误（进一步的尝试可以修复）和知识缺口（重试无法解决）。专家反馈可以解决后者，但专家的注意力是稀缺资源。因此，关键挑战不在于是否请求反馈，而在于在何处请求反馈才能改变结果。现有方法要么完全避免使用专家反馈，导致智能体不断强化自身的错误；要么在任务层面分配反馈，而未能识别出关键的决策点。我们提出了SynAct，这是一个主动学习框架，它将专家注意力视为约束性瓶颈资源，并在单个决策的层面分配反馈。SynAct通过在多次重复rollout中计算所选动作与最终结果之间的互信息来对决策进行排序，在价值最高的决策处向专家查询，并将所得的修正提炼为可迁移的规则。
tldr: 提出SynAct主动学习框架，将专家注意力视为稀缺约束资源，利用动作与最终结果之间的互信息对决策排序，在最能改变结果的关键决策点精准请求专家反馈并提炼为可迁移规则，从而弥补LLM智能体的知识缺口。
en_tdlr: SynAct is an active learning framework that treats expert attention as a binding constraint, ranks individual decisions by the mutual information between actions and terminal outcomes across rollouts, and queries experts only at the highest-value decisions to distill corrections into transferable rules.
